item.title: Trump Says Iran Deal "Very Possible" Following Latest Talks
item.description: US President Donald Trump said the US has had "very good talks" with Iran in the last 24 hours, leaving the door open to a possible deal. The statement comes after a series of diplomatic efforts to revive the stalled nuclear agreement.

item.title: China Rolls Out J-35AE Stealth Jet As F-35 Rival, Pak May Be First Buyer
item.description: China has unveiled the J-35AE stealth jet, a rival to the F-35, with Pakistan potentially being its first buyer. The export-focused model is expected to mirror its domestic counterpart in performance, marking a significant development in China's military aviation capabilities.

item.title: US says warplane disabled ship that tried to break Iran port blockade
item.description: A US warplane damaged an Iranian oil tanker's rudder after it tried to break a US blockade of Iranian ports. The incident highlights the ongoing tensions between the two nations and the US efforts to enforce its maritime restrictions.

item.description: AirAsia has ordered 150 Airbus A220 jets worth $19 billion, a significant deal for the European aircraft manufacturer. The order underscores the growing demand for the A220, a popular choice among low-cost carriers.
